channel.description: Last 10 notes on 🌍 Globe Seekers Campaign

item.title: Water Rats
item.description: v Water Rats: A Faction of Mutant Genasi The Water Rats are a faction of mutant Genasi of Water who reside in the sewers of Airspur.

item.title: Withered Thumb
item.description: The Withered Thumb druids are a group of druids experimenting with dark magic in Cragmaw Castle.

item.title: Beastman
item.description: The Beastmen originate from Verdantia (Verdant Heart), a Prime Plane rich in diverse ecosystems ranging from sprawling forests to living mountains.

item.title: Crystallines
item.description: Hailing from the Crystallia Crystal Expanse (Lux’crystallos), the Crystallines have uniquely evolved into various species, including gnomes and their kin.

item.title: Deepling
item.description: Originating from Umbria (UM), the Deepling have diversified into various subterranean species adapted to life in darkness and confined spaces.

item.title: Draconid
item.description: From the elemental plane of Draconis (The Dragonheart Plane) emerge the Draconids, a formidable family of dragon-like beings that have evolved into diverse species, including Dragonborn and Kobolds.
